userPrompt: Give me a recipe idea using eggs and spinach.
responseText:
**Spinach & Egg Skillet (5 min)**

Sauté a big handful of fresh spinach in olive oil with a pinch of salt and garlic until wilted.  
Crack 2–3 eggs directly on top, cover, and cook until whites set but yolks are still runny.  
Finish with black pepper, chili flakes, and a squeeze of lemon.

High-protein, one-pan, zero waste. Eat straight from the pan.
